overpass.purpose: Category-based POI search (46 categories, e.g. restaurants, pharmacies, ATMs) using OpenStreetMap data
overpass.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates, POI category (OSM tag filters)
overpass.dataReceived: OSM elements with name, coordinates, tags (address, phone, website, opening_hours, category)

overpass-kumi.purpose: Rate-limit fallback Overpass mirror (Kumi Systems e.U., Austria), used only when the primary Overpass endpoint is rate-limited or unavailable
overpass-kumi.dataSent: The Overpass QL query containing the map-viewport bounding box and POI category (OSM tag filters), sent server-side only when the primary endpoint is unavailable
overpass-kumi.dataReceived: OSM elements with name, coordinates, tags (address, phone, website, opening_hours, category)
